name: fucustomer
description: 奧客退散 FUCustomer — first-person co-op store management (1-5 players)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/sim.test.ts tests/career.test.ts tests/achievements.test.ts tests/story.test.ts tests/ownstore.test.ts tests/maps.test.ts tests/mapkarens.test.ts tests/sigkarens.test.ts tests/karendex.test.ts tests/friends.test.ts tests/font.test.ts tests/auth.test.ts tests/shop.test.ts tests/savecode.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/solo-smoke.mjs && node tests/e2e/multi-browser.mjs && node tests/e2e/career.mjs && node tests/e2e/round3.mjs && node tests/e2e/offline.mjs && node tests/e2e/round7.mjs && node tests/e2e/round8.mjs && node tests/e2e/round9.mjs && node tests/e2e/round10.mjs && node tests/e2e/maps.mjs && node tests/e2e/round11.mjs && node tests/e2e/round12.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:net
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:client && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win
